feedback_text: The course was well-structured, but the weekly assignments were a bit too long.
I really enjoyed the guest lectures. They provided great real-world context.
The mid-term exam was much harder than the practice problems provided.
The professor explains complex concepts very clearly. Highly recommended.
I wish there were more office hours available. It's hard to get help.
The reading list was very diverse and interesting. I loved the poetry section.
The grading criteria for the essays were a bit ambiguous.
The lab sessions were disorganized and some equipment didn't work.
Great course overall, but the textbook is extremely expensive.
The online platform for submitting code was frequently down.
